title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 6)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 6), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines the concepts of anthropomorphism attributed to Ibn Taymiyya and his followers as part of the Al-Tawhid series.
